model_output.verdict: A construction project manager whose resume makes project values, trade coordination and delivery results easy to see.
write_up: This is a strong construction project management resume! At Capitol Builders, you show the value and number of projects you run, the trades you manage and the results you've delivered. A recruiter can quickly connect your experience to commercial tenant improvements and ground-up retail.

The grocery store line is especially good: it names the build, its value and the schedule result. Your move from Assistant Project Manager to Project Manager is easy to follow, and your construction management degree and tools sit where a recruiter would expect them.
Your resume isn't the weak link here. The competition for a particular job will still matter. Before sending it, add how you kept change orders down if you can describe your part accurately.

cards.line: - Delivered a $14M grocery store build 3 weeks ahead of schedule in 2024
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It gives the recruiter a named kind of build and a concrete result, not just a list of duties.

cards.line: - Kept change orders under 3% of contract value across 2024 and 2025 projects
cards.cannot_tell: Keeping change orders under 3% is a useful result. What did you do to keep them there?
cards.example: Kept change orders under 3% of contract value across 2024 and 2025 projects by [what you did]
cards.question: What did you do to keep change orders under 3% on those projects?

fit.note: Your experience points toward construction project management for commercial tenant improvements and ground-up retail. The Capitol Builders role shows responsibility for concurrent projects, subcontractor buyout and delivery.
